name: 1112-sharedprefix-gemma2-9b-1gpu
model: unsloth/gemma-2-9b-it -- an ungated re-upload of google/gemma-2-9b-it; the Gemma Terms of Use apply. Same weights, config verified field for field.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
architecture: Gemma2ForCausalLM, 42 layers, 16 query heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 256, hidden 3584, intermediate 14336, vocab 256000, 8192 trained positions, ~18.5 GB of bf16 weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 640 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, over `/v1/completions`. Four fixed preambles of 4096 tokens each, drawn uniformly, followed by a 256-token tail that is different every time and a 64-token generation. Lengths are pinned exactly (min == max). Seed 42.
purpose: A nine-billion-parameter assistant answering 4K-token briefs from four shared preambles, eight concurrent users, single GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments for sglang at commit 9195d1362aa33db052c01fb9589301299d6fc50c
# (`git describe --tags` = v0.2.12-30-g9195d1362aa).
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- a structured value must stay on ONE line: the reader takes this
# file line by line and skips indented ones, so a re-flowed block mapping drops the key and
# the server starts without it at rc=0.
#
# host / port / served-model-name are set by whoever launches the server.

model-path: unsloth/gemma-2-9b-it
tp-size: 1
context-length: 8192
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
chunked-prefill-size: -1
max-running-requests: 16
random-seed: 42
